## Faster Unslop and a complete copyable setup

- Unslop searches for transition phrases before checking their sentence boundaries, avoiding repeated whitespace scans through masked code blocks. Prek can now lint independent Markdown batches in parallel.
- A 3,662-file repository scan dropped from 14.2 seconds to 1.3 seconds with the same 701 diagnostics. CI checks exact diagnostic locations and a 20,000-line code block with a timeout.
- `example_conf/` contains all 12 hooks, strict lint settings, formatter configuration, and a GitHub Actions workflow. Ruff and Oxfmt use a 300-character line width. Release preparation updates the example version, and CI tests the copied setup.
- Hook fixtures cover all 12 hooks and all 15 custom Oxlint rules. Fixtures and calibration examples live under `.ci/fixtures/`; Go helper commands live under `tools/`.
